description: This file defines a request handler class 'GetMyOrdersHandler' which processes 'GetMyOrders' requests to retrieve a list of orders for a specific user. It uses repository pattern and specification pattern to query order data and maps it to view models.

classes.name: GetMyOrdersHandler
classes.description: A request handler that retrieves user-specific order data and maps it to order view models.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles the 'GetMyOrders' request by creating a specification, querying the repository for orders, and returning a list of order view models.
